title: Electrochemical Process Extracts Pure Hydrogen from Ammonia
summary: An MIT team has demonstrated a more efficient way to extract pure hydrogen gas from hydrogen carrier molecules.

title: Hexagon Launches Redesigned OPTIV S Optical CMM
summary: The multisensor platform combines vision and tactile inspection with AI-assisted edge detection, autofocus, and lighting functions.

title: Bam Cranes Footbridge into Place at Leyton Station
summary: A new steel footbridge was craned into place at Leyton Underground station in north London during an overnight operation.

title: Qualcomm and Amazon Expand AI Infrastructure Partnership
summary: The companies will develop customized silicon for AI inference and optical connectivity solutions up to 1.6T.

title: VolkerRail Completes Sheffield Supertram Track Renewal Early
summary: The renewal of the track at the Supertram Delta Junction in Sheffield has been completed ahead of schedule by VolkerRail.

title: US Battery Installations Reach Record High
summary: Battery installations hit a new record in the US in the second quarter of 2026, bringing 20.2 gigawatt-hours of new capacity online.

summary: Excessive wiring, heat, and latency are forcing quantum control electronics deeper into cryogenic temperatures.

summary: DwarfLab's Draco smart telescope features a sensor that physically spins to cancel out star trails caused by Earth's rotation.

title: Can GPUs Maintain Dominance in AI Compute?
summary: Alternative competitive chips from companies like Google, Amazon, and OpenAI are gaining market share.

summary: Scientists discovered an atomic structure on nickel oxide that allows a low-nickel catalyst to rival ones containing ten times more metal.

summary: Researchers used skeletal muscle from a frog leg as an actuator to control a tiny robotic manta ray.

title: Stoke Space Secures $1B for Reusable Rockets
summary: Stoke Space raised $1 billion to develop its fully reusable Nova rockets and targets early 2027 for its first launch.

title: New York University Engineers Build Scalable Robotic Fish
summary: Researchers at NYU have developed a robotic fish capable of being built to any size, drawing inspiration from nature.

summary: Researchers introduced TANGO, a whole-byte vision-language-action framework for language-conditioned humanoid traversal in cluttered environments.

summary: Researchers developed DeCAL, a physically-grounded dexterous vision-language-action model that unifies understanding, imagination, and action generation.

summary: Researchers derived single- and multi-frequency omnidirectional path loss models for urban microcell environments based on extensive empirical data.

summary: An augmented particle filter helps autonomous surface vessels maintain accurate target tracking estimates during intermittent communications.

title: Efficient Quantile-Resolved Hosting Capacity Assessment for Grids
summary: A new computational method significantly reduces the time needed to assess hosting capacity distributions on low-voltage grids.

title: DYAD Multimodal Dataset for Human Assistance

title: Robot Motion as a Physical Communication Channel

title: Perception-Aware Humanoid Design Increases Workspace Coverage

summary: A new method called FRAME enables language-guided robots to accurately retrieve objects from scene memories using multi-attribute natural language queries.

summary: CAST uses planner-guided behavior to improve value learning and successfully transfers to a physical quadruped performing a dynamic handstand.

title: FIRE3D Fast 3D Scene Reconstruction
